_comment: Hand-authored prose for RunicClasses. tools/generate_classes.py reads this file and the kit table in
generate_classes.py and writes assets/runicclasses/lang/en_us.json; never hand-edit that output.
Lore rules (docs/plan.md 3.15): suite-generic vocabulary only (Aptitudes, Runic Marks/Seals/Crowns, Perks,
runes); a named mechanic and both Aptitudes in bold, primary first; one sentence on the Mark/Seal/Crown
ladder and one on the party role; no numbers; purely positive; no setting proper nouns. Perk descriptions
take %s placeholders in the order of the perk's values in the kit table; literal percent signs are %%.
Power descriptions are plain text, so their percent signs are always %%.

barbarian.name: Barbarian
barbarian.lore: A §lBarbarian§r fights from the gut. Their craft is §lFury§r: the heat that rises as the wounds pile up, turning every hit they take into a reason to hit back harder. Barbarians run on §lStrength§r first and §lConstitution§r second; their Runic Mark answers a bloodied blow with a heavier one, their Seal turns a kill into a roar that clears the ground around them, and their Crown is the moment a crushing hit makes them harder to stop rather than easier. In a company they stand where the fighting is thickest and draw it toward themselves. Some found the Fury in hard country, some in the fighting pits, and some simply found it waiting when nothing else was left.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.lore: A §lFighter§r is the soldier the rest of the company stands behind. Their craft is §lDrill§r: the thousand repetitions that turn a sword, an axe or a spear into an extension of the arm, and a shield into a wall that answers back. Fighters run on §lStrength§r first and §lEndurance§r second; their Runic Mark rewards the patient first cut, their Seal turns a raised shield into cover for everyone beside them, and their Crown is the last stand that refuses to end a fight on anyone's terms but theirs. Knights, caravan guards and sellswords all drill the same forms. What they do with the forms is their own business.

monk.name: Monk
monk.lore: A §lMonk§r carries nothing they cannot carry inside themselves. Their craft is §lBreath§r: the steady rhythm that keeps the body light, the hands quick and the mind still, so that an open palm lands like a blade. Monks run on §lDexterity§r first and §lEndurance§r second; their Runic Mark opens a guard with a single precise strike, their Seal gathers a flurry of blows into one shuddering impact, and their Crown lets a perfectly centred body slip a blow that should have broken it. In a company they move where others cannot, unburdened and unhurried. Some learned the Breath in quiet halls, some on the road, and some taught themselves.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.lore: A §lRogue§r wins before the other side knows a fight has started. Their craft is §lEdgework§r: the precise placement of one blade, one lockpick, one quiet step. Rogues run on §lDexterity§r first and §lFortune§r second; their Runic Mark opens a fight with a cut that marks the target, their Seal lets a kill fold them back into the dark, and their Crown collects on every wound they have opened at once. Some work the alleys of a city, some the halls beneath a ruin. All of them prefer one perfect strike to a hundred honest ones.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.lore: A §lRanger§r keeps §lThe Long Watch§r over the places between settlements: the forest edges, the high passes and the long roads where help is days away. Their craft is patience at a distance, reading a trail, a wind and a bowstring together until the shot is already decided. Rangers run on §lDexterity§r first and §lWisdom§r second; their Runic Mark sends a second arrow after a long first one, their Seal pins a quarry where it stands, and their Crown answers a run of clean hits with a volley that fills the sky. In a company they see the danger first and settle it before it closes. The animals that walk beside them fight a little harder for it.

bard.name: Bard
bard.lore: A §lBard§r turns a fight into a performance and a company into a chorus. Their craft is §lCadence§r: the rhythm of verse, drum and voice that steadies an ally's hands and sours an enemy's footing. Bards run on §lIntelligence§r first and §lFortune§r second; their Runic Mark opens an encounter with a verse that quickens everyone near, their Seal answers a strike with a discord that weakens every foe around it, and their Crown is the anthem that catches a falling friend. Bards learn quickly, bargain well and travel light. Wherever a company gathers, the Bard is the reason it holds together a little longer than anyone expected.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.lore: A §lCleric§r carries the §lRites§r: the spoken forms through which a chosen power reaches into the world to mend, to ward and to break what should not walk. Clerics run on §lWisdom§r first and §lMagic§r second; their Runic Mark turns a fallen undead into light for their companions, their Seal shields an ally the moment a blow lands too hard, and their Crown makes every healing a rallying call. Temples train them, but the Rites answer anyone who keeps them faithfully, altar or no altar.

druid.name: Druid
druid.lore: A §lDruid§r keeps §lThe Green Covenant§r: a promise between the one who tends the wild and the wild that tends them back. Bark hardens under their feet, rain mends them and crops grow faster in their company. Druids run on §lMagic§r first and §lEndurance§r second; their Runic Mark lets a vine catch whatever they strike, their Seal wraps them in thorns that answer a heavy blow, and their Crown calls the whole grove to their side when they falter. In a company they are the one who keeps everyone fed and on their feet. Some keep the Covenant in deep forest, some at the edge of a single field.

sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
sorcerer.lore: A §lSorcerer§r was born with magic already running through them. Their craft is the §lWild Vein§r: a current of power they never studied for, only learned to ride, and that answers best when it is pushed. Sorcerers run on §lMagic§r first and §lConstitution§r second, because a body that carries the Vein grows strong enough to bear it; their Runic Mark sharpens a first strike against an untouched foe, their Seal returns what a killing spell spent, and their Crown lets the Vein surge outward in a burst no one, not even the Sorcerer, can quite predict. In a company they are the spark that turns a stand-off into a rout.

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.lore: A §lWarlock§r struck a deal and keeps collecting on it. Their craft is §lThe Bargain§r: power taken on terms and repaid in the lives of their enemies and the luck of the draw. Warlocks run on §lMagic§r first and §lFortune§r second; their Runic Mark drinks a little life from any weakened foe, their Seal spreads the shadow of a kill across everything nearby, and their Crown is the moment the debt comes due and every enemy in reach pays it at once. Who sits across the table from a Warlock is their own affair, and most prefer it that way. In a company they are the one the enemy least wants to get close to.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.lore: A §lWizard§r treats magic as a discipline to be mastered. Their craft is §lThe Study§r: notes, diagrams and patient repetition until a working is understood rather than merely cast. Wizards run on §lIntelligence§r first and §lMagic§r second; their Runic Mark strikes harder against any creature they have studied before, their Seal reclaims the effort a successful spell spent, and their Crown is a grand working built from a run of lesser ones. Wizards enchant with a keen eye and learn faster than anyone. In a company they are the reference everyone checks before trying something dangerous, and the reason the dangerous thing works.

artificer.name: Artificer
artificer.lore: An §lArtificer§r blends rune-lore with mechanical engineering to make better gear. Rather than waving a wand, an Artificer works magic through artisans' tools, laying it into an item as clockwork, as a mixture or as a rune cut into steel. Their defining craft is §lInfusions§r: refinements that make the tools and weapons they build tougher, sharper and luckier than the recipe promises. Artificers run on §lIntelligence§r first and §lTinkering§r second; their Runic Mark turns any working tool into a weapon, their Seal mends a failing tool at the last moment, and their Crown stores every hit in a capacitor until it arcs outward. In a company they are the problem-solver who keeps everyone's gear in fighting shape.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.lore: A §lPaladin§r is bound by §lThe Oath§r: a promise to stand between harm and the people who cannot stand against it. The Oath hardens them and everyone close to them, and it does not let a companion fall while the Paladin still stands. Paladins run on §lConstitution§r first and §lWisdom§r second; their Runic Mark answers anyone who wounds a friend, their Seal turns a held shield into protection for the whole line, and their Crown is the avatar the Oath makes of them when the fight turns desperate. Some swear the Oath at an altar, some in a storm, some over a grave. Every one of them keeps it.

classless.name: Classless
classless.lore: To be §lClassless§r is to walk your own road. A Classless adventurer takes no class Perks, no class Powers and no head start in any Aptitude, and answers to no discipline: every level they earn goes wherever they choose. Many begin this way and take up a class later with a Class Orb. Some never do, and are proud of it.

cls_barbarian_fury_rising: When a melee hit leaves you at or below 50%% health, your next melee hit within 4 seconds deals 20%% more damage. Internal cooldown: 6 seconds.
cls_barbarian_blood_roar: Killing a hostile creature while at or below 50%% health heals you for 10%% of your maximum health and throws back enemies within 3 blocks. Internal cooldown: 15 seconds.
cls_barbarian_unbroken: A single hit that costs you 30%% or more of your maximum health grants Resistance II and Strength II for 6 seconds. Internal cooldown: 60 seconds.
cls_fighter_measured_cut: Your first melee hit after 5 seconds without attacking deals 30%% more damage. Internal cooldown: 8 seconds.
cls_fighter_bulwark_call: Blocking an attack grants Resistance I for 4 seconds to you and allies within 4 blocks. Internal cooldown: 20 seconds.
cls_fighter_last_stand: When your health drops below 25%%, gain Absorption IV for 10 seconds; while it lasts, each melee hit heals you for 1 health. Internal cooldown: 120 seconds.
cls_monk_opening_palm: An unarmed hit on a target you have not struck in 5 seconds applies Weakness I for 3 seconds. Internal cooldown: 6 seconds.
cls_monk_quivering_strike: Every fifth unarmed hit on the same target deals bonus damage equal to 10%% of its maximum health, up to 20. Internal cooldown: 12 seconds.
cls_monk_perfect_form: While you wear no iron or heavier armor, a hit that would cost you 40%% or more of your maximum health is negated and you gain Speed II for 4 seconds. Internal cooldown: 90 seconds.
cls_rogue_opening_cut: Your first hit on a target at full health makes it glow and applies Weakness I for 4 seconds. Internal cooldown: 8 seconds.
cls_rogue_vanish: Killing a hostile creature grants Invisibility and Speed I for 4 seconds. Internal cooldown: 20 seconds.
cls_rogue_deathmark: Landing four hits on the same target within 5 seconds detonates a quarter of the damage you dealt it in that time, up to 20. Internal cooldown: 45 seconds.
cls_ranger_second_arrow: A projectile hit from 12 or more blocks away is followed by a second strike for half its damage. Internal cooldown: 6 seconds.
cls_ranger_pin: A fully drawn arrow roots its target with Slowness V for 2 seconds. Internal cooldown: 15 seconds.
cls_ranger_volley_of_the_watch: Landing three projectile hits within 4 seconds splits your next arrow into three. Internal cooldown: 40 seconds.
cls_bard_opening_verse: Your first hit after 10 seconds out of combat grants Speed I for 4 seconds to you and allies within 8 blocks. Internal cooldown: 12 seconds.
cls_bard_dissonance: Striking a target applies Weakness I and Slowness I for 4 seconds to enemies within 4 blocks of it. Internal cooldown: 20 seconds.
cls_bard_anthem: When you or an ally within 10 blocks drops below 30%% health, they gain Absorption II and Regeneration II for 6 seconds. Internal cooldown: 90 seconds.
cls_cleric_radiant_burst: Killing an undead heals you for 2 health and allies within 4 blocks for 1. Internal cooldown: 5 seconds.
cls_cleric_ward_of_light: When you or an ally within 8 blocks loses 20%% or more of their maximum health to one hit, they gain Absorption I for 5 seconds. Internal cooldown: 15 seconds.
cls_cleric_beacon: Healing an ally with a healing spell or a thrown healing potion makes you a beacon for 8 seconds: you and allies within 8 blocks deal 15%% more damage and gain Regeneration I. Internal cooldown: 60 seconds.
cls_druid_vine_lash: Hitting a target while you stand on natural ground applies Slowness II for 3 seconds. Internal cooldown: 8 seconds.
cls_druid_thorned_mantle: A hit that costs you 15%% or more of your maximum health deals 4 damage and applies Poison I for 3 seconds to enemies within 3 blocks. Internal cooldown: 15 seconds.
cls_druid_heart_of_the_grove: Dropping below 30%% health grants Regeneration III for 5 seconds and roots enemies within 5 blocks with Slowness V for 2 seconds. Internal cooldown: 90 seconds.
cls_sorcerer_sparkvein: Magic damage against an enemy at full health is 15%% higher. Internal cooldown: 6 seconds.
cls_sorcerer_cascade: Killing with magic refunds 20%% of your maximum mana. Without a mana system, it grants Haste II for 4 seconds instead. Internal cooldown: 15 seconds.
cls_sorcerer_arcane_upwelling: Every sixth spell you cast unleashes a random surge: lightning on your target, 4 health for you, or a blast that throws back nearby enemies. Without spells, every sixth magic hit does. Internal cooldown: 30 seconds.
cls_warlock_soul_leech: Hitting a target that has Weakness heals you for 1 health. Internal cooldown: 3 seconds.
cls_warlock_patrons_shadow: Killing a hostile creature applies Blindness and Slowness I for 3 seconds to enemies within 5 blocks. Internal cooldown: 20 seconds.
cls_warlock_the_debt_comes_due: Dropping below 20%% health deals 6 damage to every enemy within 8 blocks and heals you for 3 health per enemy struck. Internal cooldown: 120 seconds.
cls_wizard_studied_strike: Magic damage against a kind of creature you have slain before is 15%% higher. You remember up to 64 kinds. Internal cooldown: 4 seconds.
cls_wizard_recitation: A spell that kills refunds half of that spell's cooldown. Without spells, a magic kill grants Haste II for 5 seconds instead. Internal cooldown: 20 seconds.
cls_wizard_grand_working: Casting five spells within 15 seconds makes your next spell two levels higher and free. Without spells, five magic hits within 15 seconds make your next magic hit deal double damage. Internal cooldown: 60 seconds.
cls_artificer_spring_trap: Hitting with a pickaxe, axe, shovel or hoe deals 20%% more damage. Internal cooldown: 6 seconds.
cls_artificer_field_repair: When the item in your hand drops below 10%% durability, it repairs 15%% of its durability. Internal cooldown: 60 seconds.
cls_artificer_arc_capacitor: Every eighth hit you land releases an arc that deals 5 damage to up to 3 enemies within 5 blocks. Internal cooldown: 20 seconds.
cls_paladin_righteous_blow: Your first hit on an enemy that wounded you or an ally in the last 5 seconds deals 25%% more damage. Internal cooldown: 8 seconds.
cls_paladin_aegis: Blocking three attacks within 5 seconds grants Resistance I for 4 seconds to you and allies within 6 blocks. Internal cooldown: 20 seconds.
cls_paladin_avatar_of_the_oath: Dropping below 25%% health grants Absorption III, and for 8 seconds each of your hits heals the nearest ally for 2 health, or you if no ally is near. Internal cooldown: 120 seconds.
